During the early days of the [[Galactic War]], an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] task force '''ambushed''' the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] ''[[Intercessor]]'' above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vondoru]]. Three [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]] engaged the ''Intercessor'' and damaged the ship, but [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] reinforcements in the form of several [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvettes]] and three [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-clas corvettes]] arrived near Vondoru.

However, fighters from the elite [[Empire's Fury]] starfighter squadron soon came to the Imperial destroyers' aid, and the task force engaged the Republic ships in the atmosphere of Vondoru. The ''Intercessor'' and its escorts released many [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Talon''-class starfighters]], but the Emperor's Fury fighters inflicted heavy damage on the Republic corvettes and disabled the ''Intercessor''{{'s}} shield generators and defenses, allowing the Imperials to capture the crippled flagship.
